response.overview: Abhinav, an astrophysicist living in Kolkata India is on a mission to search for possibilities whether time travel is possible or not. He stays alone in a flat and most of the time he is busy playing with his tools and learning new techniques to build up a technology based on Stephen Hawking's theory of space and time. He makes a model that he believes can serve the purpose of time travel but on the other hand he fails everyday but he never gives up and records every activity on a camcorder . One day after his falure, he received a mail from his old friend Kaustav to sit for a coffee chat, as he rarely meets people he agrees.
